criteriaAudit.policy: Source/export byte identity is a provenance requirement; naturally drawn body/feather/foot differences are assessed visually at intended output size. No automatic rejection is inferred solely from changed-pixel counts or a1-output-pixel foot-mask boundary change.
judged: Readable intended identity and relative size
Conspicuous interior speck/flicker or shape/scale jumps
Obvious anatomy defects and coarse stance motion

bushtit.recommendation: Provisional neutral/look intake; use neutral still if tiny foot/head changes distract on the intended background.
bushtit.identity: At28world-pixel neutral width, the tiny plump gray-brown body, very long narrow tail and short dark bill remain readable as the intended Bushtit source. Fine eye/sex details cannot be certified at this size.
bushtit.poseReadability: The brief upward bill/head look is genuine in the source and subtly visible at normal size. It is a crisp two-pose look, not a smooth multi-frame head turn.
bushtit.quietInterior: Body color groups are subdued. No conspicuous random pale/tan speck field or whole-body color flash appears in the inspected actual-size samples.
bushtit.anatomyContact: No conspicuous added limb or detached body part is visible. Coarse foot-mask lowest boundary changes1output pixel, equivalent0.667world units; centroid changes0.173world units. This is a small redraw/raster difference, not certified physical foot slip.
bushtit.minorLimit: Leg/toe/eye details collapse into very few presentation pixels. Owner should judge contact against the actual support and yard background.

bewick_s_wren.recommendation: Provisional neutral/downward-look intake. Neutral still remains a valid fallback.
bewick_s_wren.identity: Cocked long tail, brown upperparts, pale underside, white eyebrow and fine dark bill give a clear intended wren silhouette at44world pixels.
bewick_s_wren.poseReadability: The alternate is a downward inspection/head-bill nod, not an upward glance. It is readily distinguishable, with a discrete200ms hold and immediate return.
bewick_s_wren.quietInterior: Broad chest/back color grouping remains calm. Tail/wing bars and eyebrow are diagnostic markings rather than random interior speckle. Minor feather redraw is visible under comparison without a conspicuous body flash in normal-size samples.
bewick_s_wren.anatomyContact: No conspicuous extra limb, gross body collapse or detached foot is apparent. Coarse foot boundary stays fixed; centroid difference0.338world units. Fine bill curvature and anatomical toes remain unapproved.
bewick_s_wren.minorLimit: The bill profile changes with the downward pose and looks somewhat more curved; final morphology/style and actual crevice-contact approval are separate from this source look.

white_crowned_sparrow.recommendation: Provisional neutral/blink intake with neutral still fallback. Inspect its tiny raster bob/contact change during owner yard review before final approval.
white_crowned_sparrow.identity: Black-white crown pattern, pale pink/orange bill, plain gray breast and brown patterned back remain readable at54world pixels. Subspecies identification is not established by this review.
white_crowned_sparrow.poseReadability: Source eyelid closure is real. The100ms alternate is intentionally subtle at normal size; one browser sample captured the closed state and the next captured return. No invented half-lid frame or longer hold is required solely for uniformity with other species.
white_crowned_sparrow.quietInterior: The plain breast and grouped back pattern remain visually calm. Crown stripes/wing markings provide intended contrast; no conspicuous random pale/tan interior flash appears in samples.
white_crowned_sparrow.anatomyContact: Coarse lowest foot-mask boundary changes1output pixel, equivalent1.286world units, while centroid changes0.565world units. The pose also has a small silhouette/raster shift. This is disclosed as potential slight blink twitch, not automatically classified as a rigid-foot translation or an anatomy failure.
white_crowned_sparrow.minorLimit: Owner should decide whether the brief body/foot edge twitch is distracting on the yard support. If it is, prefer the supplied neutral rather than forcing a new generation or claiming the blink is accepted.

quietStyleAssessment.observed: At the declared world sizes, these three sources use subdued gray/brown interior color groups with clear species markings. No conspicuous random pale/tan mottling or distracting whole-body flash is visible in the inspected samples.
quietStyleAssessment.limits: The native art still contains fine feather texture. This visual assessment is not a universal palette/component-count gate and not a controlled comparison against the owner's unavailable screenshot.
quietStyleAssessment.noPixelPostprocessingClaim: No reviewer recoloring, smoothing, texture cleanup or source edits were performed.

scaleAndContactInterpretation.scaleOrder: The tiny Bushtit, larger upright-tailed wren and larger sparrow are sensibly ordered as a presentation proposal.
scaleAndContactInterpretation.scaleCaveat: Neutral image bounding-box width is the declared practical proxy; it is not independently calibrated biological bill-to-tail length. Same density/export scale is retained for both poses within each species.
scaleAndContactInterpretation.contactTechnicalOnly: Declared same contact pixels are alpha-positive in both poses. This supports technical registration, not anatomical toe-center identity or true support contact.
scaleAndContactInterpretation.rasterCaveat: Coarse alpha128 foot masks change with few-pixel texture and thresholding. Centroid/boundary numbers are not anatomical tracking or automatic semantic pass/fail criteria.

timing.meaning: Different durations are legitimate behavior choices. Exact neutral endpoints establish no endpoint mismatch; visual transition suitability is assessed separately.

normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.method: page.set_content of exact retained HTML; normal APNG speed, unique Blob URL per restart
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.runtimeEnvironment: Cloud Linux headless Chromium, DPR1; standalone retained HTML, not Mac app.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.samplingLimit: Normal-speed APNGs ran without manual phase stepping. Timestamped screenshots were inspected chronologically. Screenshot capture spans and load/compositor origin limit exact frame-boundary timing; sampling is not continuous human video judgment.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.renderingMethod: Supported page.set_content used the self-contained retained HTML; unique Blob URLs restarted exact embedded APNG bytes. No network/proxy/policy change or file navigation was needed.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.evidenceRetention: Actual-size contact-sheet PNGs are embedded here; no separate reviewer image files were written.
